description: Define Silver schema for trades tables (Polymarket and Kalshi scaffold)
steps: Define `silver_polymarket.trades` PyIceberg schema (timestamp, market_id, maker, taker, nonusdc_side, maker_direction, taker_direction, price, usd_amount, token_amount, transaction_hash, etc.)
Define `silver_kalshi.trades` PyIceberg schema (scaffold, no data yet)
Add metadata fields: `bronze_run_id`, `silver_ingestion_ts`, `dedup_key`
Define dedup key for trades: `(platform, platform_trade_id)` or content hash

description: Define Silver schema for markets tables
steps: Define `silver_polymarket.markets` schema (flatten key fields from Gamma API JSON)
Define `silver_kalshi.markets` schema (scaffold)
Define dedup key: `(platform, platform_market_id, updated_at)`
Add change tracking fields: `first_seen_at`, `last_updated_at`

description: Define Silver schema for events tables
steps: Define `silver_polymarket.events` schema (flatten key fields from Gamma API JSON)
Define `silver_kalshi.events` schema (scaffold)
Define dedup key for events

description: Build normalizer interface and implement per-entity normalizers
steps: Create `silver/normalize.py` with base normalizer interface
Implement `PolymarketMarketsNormalizer`
Implement `PolymarketEventsNormalizer`
Implement scaffold normalizers for Kalshi (trades, markets, events)
Handle type conversions: string timestamps to UTC datetime, numeric strings to typed values
Handle missing/null fields with defaults or explicit errors

description: Unit tests for schemas and normalizers
steps: Unit tests for each normalizer with sample Bronze JSON records
Test null handling and default values
Test type conversion edge cases (invalid timestamps, malformed numbers)
Create test fixtures from real Bronze data samples
